comment: Captured once from the published npm tarballs effect-dynamodb@1.40.0 (sha256 9aff9b37084725223f881b579e5876efd6f0bf0716a022d17a11b3b831cd749d) and @effect-dynamodb/schema@1.40.0 (sha256 af8944bcce4578e0c0f2fc674901544382ac8f03f2a61ed4d81f8be790dbf858), by running helpers/SparseEntryOps.ts's captureWithRequests for every case on the recording table (helpers/RecordingTable.ts, as of #243), with Date.now and crypto.getRandomValues fixed as SparseEntryOps.test.ts fixes them: every request 1.40.0 sent, whole, in order.
